The '''Separatist droid speeder''' was a lean and heavily armed military [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] operated by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|army]] during<ref name="CW Toy" /> the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the Republic.<ref name="TCW">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref> The [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] had eight built-in [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] that fired [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts, and its [[Wing (technology)|wings]] could be folded down for greater maneuverability during combat. It was also equipped with a hatch below its rear that could be opened to release a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]]. The repulsorcraft had a gray and blue paint-scheme with an inverted blue [[Separatist hex icon/Legends|Confederate Roundel]] on both sides of its nose. During the Clone Wars, a blue-painted B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used the Separatist [[Droid/Legends|droid]] speeder on<ref name="CW Toy" /> the temperate [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|rugosa|Rugosa}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Separatist droid speeder was released by [[Hasbro]] in [[2011]] as part of the second wave of the "Shadows of the Dark Side" toys, which in turn were a part of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' toy line]].<ref name="CW Toy" />
